def dt_format_to_regex(fmt):
    result = []
    last_end = 0
    for m in re.finditer(r'%%|%[a-zA-Z]', fmt):
        start, end = m.span()
        # escape preceding literal
        result.append(re.escape(fmt[last_end:start]))
        directive = m.group()
        if directive == '%%':
            result.append('%')
        else:
            result.append(DIRECTIVE_MAP.get(directive, r'\w+'))
        last_end = end
    result.append(re.escape(fmt[last_end:]))
    return ''.join(result)
